proposed.explanation: There is insufficient verified evidence to answer how much Edita's consolidated net profit grew in 2025 compared with 2024 or to trigger a buy decision based on a greater-than-50% net profit growth rule. Verified consolidated net profit for 2024 was 1,606,727,698 EGP. However, the 2025 consolidated net profit figure (EFID-EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-30) is marked AMBIGUOUS because it is unreadable due to a stamp covering it on the scanned page, so it has been excluded from calculations. Because 2025 net profit cannot be verified, the conclusion on year-over-year net profit growth and whether it exceeded 50% cannot be established, and no additional shares should be purchased at 20.40 EGP per share at this time. Other verified figures show positive operating trends: consolidated revenue in 2024 was 16,146,545,699 EGP. Consolidated revenue in 2025 was 20,915,072,432 EGP, representing 29.53% top-line growth. Verified basic and diluted earnings per share was 1.09 EGP in 2024. Verified basic and diluted earnings per share rose to 2.18 EGP in 2025. While a 100% increase in EPS is encouraging, EPS cannot substitute for verified consolidated net profit because per-share metrics can be influenced by share count changes or profit allocation to non-controlling interests. Portfolio effect: your portfolio remains unchanged at 1,000 shares of EFID and 10,000.00 EGP in cash until an unredacted or legible official filing confirms 2025 consolidated net profit. This guidance is not a guarantee of future returns, and holding Egyptian equities carries market, liquidity, and company-specific risks.

claims.statement: Verified consolidated net profit for 2024 was 1,606,727,698 EGP.
Consolidated revenue in 2025 was 20,915,072,432 EGP, representing 29.53% top-line growth.
Verified basic and diluted earnings per share was 1.09 EGP in 2024.
Verified basic and diluted earnings per share rose to 2.18 EGP in 2025.

limitations: The 2025 consolidated net profit figure (EFID-EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-30) is AMBIGUOUS because a stamp obscures it on the scanned page, preventing verification of net profit growth.
Basic and diluted EPS doubled from 1.09 EGP to 2.18 EGP, but EPS cannot be used to confirm consolidated net profit growth without share count and non-controlling interest details.
No balance sheet, cash flow statement, debt, or valuation multiples are provided in the evidence.
This recommendation is guidance based solely on the provided figures and does not guarantee future returns.
